description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动低压60型混凝土泵的动力文字印成：电机功率是75 kW。电机格是电机上的千瓦。柴油格只写这一页真正印出的发动机行。画面「Mortar (masonry)」的主体是Brick and block laying。它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

h1.en: Which Power Cell Electric Low Pressure 60 Concrete Pump Prints
h1.zh: 电动低压60型混凝土泵的动力格子印了什么

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints the Electric Low Pressure 60 Concrete Pump power text in Xingtai as: Motor Power is 75 kW. An electric motor cell is kilowatts on a motor. A diesel cell names the engine line that is actually printed. The frame “Mortar (masonry)” shows Brick and block laying. It does not change this power cell, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动低压60型混凝土泵的动力文字印成：电机功率是75 kW。电机格是电机上的千瓦。柴油格只写这一页真正印出的发动机行。画面「Mortar (masonry)」的主体是Brick and block laying。它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

heading.en: Read the power label that is present
heading.zh: 只读已经印出的动力标题

body.en: Motor Power is 75 kW. Electric drive and diesel drive are different supplies. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. Theoretical Output remains 35 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure remains 30 MPa.
body.zh: 电机功率是75 kW。电动和柴油是两种供电。用这一页的标题，不用旁边那个型号的标题。理论输送量仍是35 m³/h。最大出口压力仍是30 MPa。

heading.en: A power-unit frame is not a nameplate
heading.zh: 动力装置画面不是铭牌

body.en: The frame is from en.wikipedia.org, “Mortar (masonry)”, and its subject is Brick and block laying. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. If this row has no voltage cell, none is invented.
body.zh: 这一帧来自 en.wikipedia.org 的「Mortar (masonry)」，主体是Brick and block laying。河北品锦机械不从这一帧里提取千瓦或发动机代号。这一行如果没有电压格，就不编一个电压。

heading.en: Power does not set the pipe size

body.en: Hopper Capacity 0.5 m³. Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 100. Those cells, when printed, stay in their own columns. A larger motor cell is not a longer pipeline.
body.zh: 料斗容积 0.5 m³。细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m。液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 100。这些格子如果印了，就留在各自的列里。电机千瓦更大，并不等于管路更长。

question.en: What power text does Electric Low Pressure 60 Concrete Pump print?
question.zh: 电动低压60型混凝土泵的动力文字是什么？

question.en: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?
question.zh: 可以把柴油机代号挪到这一行吗？

answer.en: Only if this row already prints it. Otherwise the cell stays as written.
answer.zh: 只有这一行已经印了才能算。否则格子保持原样。

question.en: Does the frame show the Xingtai kilowatts?
question.zh: 这一帧显示了邢台的千瓦吗？

answer.en: No. Kilowatts are taken from the catalogue cell, not from the frame.
answer.zh: 没有。千瓦取自目录格，不取自这一帧。

question.en: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
question.zh: 这一页的输送量和压力是多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 35 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure is 30 MPa.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是35 m³/h。最大出口压力是30 MPa。
